SSC JE Result 2025-26 OUT! The Staff Selection Commission has announced the SSC JE Tier 1 Result 2025-26 on 6th March 2026 at the official website ssc.gov.in. Candidates can check the Scorecard PDF to confirm their selection in the examination. Shortlisted candidates have been called for the SSC JE Tier 2 Exam which is scheduled in 4th week of March 2026 (tentatively). Along with the SSC JE Selection List 2025-26 candidates can also check the SSC JE Tier 1 Cut Off 2025-26. Cut off is the minimum marks which must be obtained by the candidate to qualify the examination.

SSC JE Result 2025-26 Out

A total of 15,607 candidates have qualified in the SSC JE Tier 1 Result 2025-26 in Civil, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering. The Staff Selection Commission Junior Engineer Result 2026 is out on the official website. This is for the Tier 1 examination conducted between 3th to 6th December. Candidates can check their qualifying status in the result. The result contains the roll number of the candidates selected for the SSC JE Tier 2 Examination 2026. Candidates must check the SSC JE Scorecard PDF on the official website only. The SSC JE Selection Process is a three stage recruitment procedure which consists of Tier 1, Tier 2 and Document Verification.

SSC JE Tier 1 Result 2025-26 Statistics

A total of 15,607 candidates have qualified in the SSC JE Tier 1 Result 2025 and have been shortlisted for the SSC JE Tier 2 (Paper II) examination. Out of the total qualified candidates, 11,593 candidates belong to the Civil Engineering stream, while 4,014 candidates are from the Electrical and Mechanical Engineering streams. Along with that OBC candidates have the highest number of qualifiers with 6,000 candidates, followed by SC candidates with 3,683 qualifiers. Additionally, 2,178 candidates from the EWS category, 1,863 candidates from the UR category, and 1,556 candidates from the ST category have also cleared Paper I. Steps to Check SSC JE Tier 1 Result 2025-26

The tier 1 result has been announced on 6th March on the official website. Check steps to access the result PDF below.

Step 1: Visit the SSC official website at ssc.gov.in.

Step 2: Click on the result tab from the homepage.

Step 3: Select SSC JE from the given list of exams.

Step 4: Click on the SSC JE result PDF for Electrical/Mechanical or Civil Engineering.

Step 5: Check all details and download the PDF for future reference.

Details Mentioned on the SSC JE Merit List PDF 2025-26

After downloading the merit list, the following details mentioned on the SSC JE Tier 1 Result:

  • Name of the candidate
  • Roll number / Registration number
  • Category (General, OBC, SC, ST, EWS, etc.)
  • Date of birth
  • Tier-wise marks obtained
  • Total score
  • Rank or merit position
  • Qualifying status for the next stage
  • Post or discipline applied for
  • Examination name and year

SSC JE Tier 1 Cut Off 2025-26

The exam authority has released the SSC JE 2026 cut off on the offiical website. Applicants who appeared in the exam can check the cut off marks. The cut off marks is released separately for Civil and Electrical/Mechanical Engineering. Applicants who scored marks equal to more more than the cut off marks are declared qualified based on the performance in the exam. Check the table below for complete details.

SSC JE Civil Engineering Cut Off

The SSC JE Civil Engineering Cut Off for Paper-I is released category-wise along with the number of candidates shortlisted for the next stage of the examination. According to the official result, the General category cut-off is 127.22748 marks, which is the highest among all categories, followed by OBC at 124.45815 marks and EWS at 117.90628 marks. For reserved categories, the cut-off stands at 109.24462 marks for SC and 106.8521 marks for ST. Among PwD categories, the cut-offs are 101.82395 for OH, 57.64407 for HH, and 40.013 marks for Other PwD candidates.

SSC JE 2025-26 Qualifying Marks

The Qualifying marks are those marks that need to be scored by a candidate in order to qualify the examination. The SSC JE Qualifying Marks are calculated in accordance with the several parameters such as the total candidates who appeared in the exam, cut off trends in the previous years, difficulty level of the exam, etc. For the SSC JE Tier 1 Examination, candidates are required to score the same in Tier I in which they will be called for the next round. The SSC JE Qualifying Marks are required as percentages that are 30 % for UR, 25 % for OBC/ EWS, 20 % for SC/ ST candidates but it may change as per the decision of the Staff Selection Commission. The SSC JE Cut off will be announced in the same PDF that contains the Merit List.

SSC JE CBT 1 Scorecard 2026

Staff Selection Commission will release the SSC Junior Engineer scorecard a few days after the declaration of the results. Applicants need to provide their registration ID and password in the required fields to download the scorecard. JE scorecard mentions applicant performance in terms of correct answers, incorrect answers, total score, normalised score, and others. Candidates are advised to keep their scorecard safe till the conclusion of the recruitment process.

What Next After SSC JE Result 2025-26?

Candidates who qualify the SSC JE Tier 1 Written Examination will be called for the Tier 2 round. The Tier 2 round is scheduled in January 2026 tentatively. Interested candidates are advised to visit the official website from time to time to get all the latest updates about the SSC JE Tier 2 Exam Date and Hall Ticket. The last round of the selection process is Document verification. The SSC JE Final Merit List PDF 2025-26 will be released after the last round i.e, DV.

SSC JE Tier 2 Exam Date 2026

Shortlisted candidates based on the tier 1 exam will have to appear for the tier 2 exam. As per the schedule, SSC JE tier 2 exam 2026 is expected to be conducted on 4th week of March 2026. Applicants are advised to regularly visit the official website for latest details. The exam authority will release the admit card separately for tier 2 exam later.

SSC JE Result 2025-26 FAQs

Ques: Is the SSC JE Result 2025-26 out?

Ans: Yes, the SSC JE Result 2025-26 has been released on 6th March 2026 the official website of SSC i.e, ssc.gov.in

Ques: Where can I check the SSC JE Result 2025-26?

Ans: You can check the SSC JE Result on the official website of SSC i.e, ssc.gov.in

Ques: What are the minimum qualifying marks for SSC JE Examination 2025-26?

Ans: The minimum qualifying marks for the SSC JE Exam is  30 % for UR, 25 % for OBC/ EWS, 20 % for SC/ ST.

Ques: What is the SSC JE Selection Process 2025-26?

Ans: The SSC JE selection process consists of 3 rounds: tier 1, tier 2 and DV.

Ques: What is the SSC JE Tier 2 Exam Date?

Ans: The SSC JE Tier 2 is tentatively scheduled in March 2026. The official announcement is still awaited.
